answer: To establish robust Sybil resistance among autonomous agents, we enforce a multi-token staking collateral coupled with a recursive zero-knowledge verifiable delay function that restricts the data inlet of new participants. This mechanism ensures that adversaries attempting to forge identity commitments face severe slashing penalties, reducing their expected attack utility to a negative value. By broadcast-routing proofs across a low-latency whisper protocol, the network maintains a secure Nash equilibrium where honest sortition remains the only profitable strategy.
